candidate.shortRationale: The term denotes existing Hering differentiated by the packing medium oil; sources directly or narrowly support herring products in oil.
Sources directly recognize pickled or marinated herring as a food category. It is broader than the existing Bismarckhering and Rollmops forms, so mapping to either would be overly narrow.
Smoking is a preparation state of the existing Hering canonical, directly supported by CIQUAL, AGRIBALYSE, and Open Food Facts records for smoked herring.
